body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Quiet ghost watcher; notices a supported danger without melodrama. Slightly eerie, still useful and intelligible. Voice direction: Low male register with an Irish accent and soft hollow chest resonance. Near-level pitch, measured stillness and a restrained airy edge. Quietly eerie without spooky performance or sound effects. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: The reply was waiting. Move the defender, and the piece is left alone. The other side can take it. Look at that connection.
